marketers.title: Earn by promoting products, listings and trips
marketers.subtitle: Three ways to work with Nawy sellers. One account, contracts handled for you, payouts per country.

influencer.name: Influencer · مؤثّر
influencer.summary: Promote products and listings for a fixed amount per campaign.
influencer.title: Become a Nawy influencer
influencer.earn1: Brands invite you, or you apply from the campaign marketplace
influencer.earn2: Contract and brief before you post
influencer.earn4: Paid when the campaign is completed
influencer.a1: Creators with an active audience on at least one social platform. Each application is reviewed by the Nawy team.
influencer.q2: How and when am I paid?
influencer.a2: The fixed campaign fee is released to your Nawy wallet once the campaign is completed, in the currency of the campaign's country.
influencer.q3: Do I need a trade licence?
influencer.a3: It depends on the country. The registration form asks only for the documents your country requires.

affiliate.name: Affiliate · مسوّق بالعمولة
affiliate.summary: Earn a percentage of every sale made through your links and code.
affiliate.title: Become a Nawy affiliate
affiliate.earn1: Share your personal links and code
affiliate.earn2: Earn a percentage of every paid sale
affiliate.earn3: Commission released after the return window
affiliate.a1: Anyone with an audience: bloggers, content sites, communities and deal pages. Applications are reviewed by the Nawy team.
affiliate.q2: How and when am I paid?
affiliate.a2: Commission on a paid sale is released once the return window has passed. You can withdraw your balance from Creator Studio.
affiliate.a3: Any product of a seller that runs an affiliate campaign in your country. Each campaign shows its commission rate.

broker.name: Broker · وسيط
broker.summary: Connect buyers and sellers for a fixed amount, a percentage, or both.
broker.title: Become a Nawy broker
broker.earn1: Connect buyers with property and listings
broker.earn2: Verified broker profile with your live listings
broker.earn4: Fixed fee, a percentage, or both
broker.a1: Licensed brokers and agencies. The registration asks for your broker licence and identity documents.
broker.q2: How and when am I paid?
broker.a2: Your agreement with each seller sets the fee: a fixed amount, a percentage, or both.
broker.a3: Yes. Nawy can grant you an exclusive contract on a listing; it then shows you as the exclusive marketer.

travel.title: Sell Umrah, Hajj and holiday packages to millions
travel.subtitle: List trips with departures and seat capacity. Travellers send booking requests on Nawy; you confirm them and collect documents in one panel.

seats.title: Seat capacity control
seats.body: Departures, room types and live seat counts

documents.title: Documents collected for you
documents.body: Passports and visas uploaded by travellers

contracts.title: Contracts built in
contracts.body: Travellers accept your trip contract before they book

requests.title: Booking requests
requests.body: Confirm or decline requests from the Travel Partner panel

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.body: Join seasonal campaigns and featured placements

travel.a1: A valid tourism or travel agency licence for your country. The registration asks for the licence number and your logo.
travel.a2: The Nawy team reviews new agencies, usually within a few working days. You can follow your application on the status page.
travel.a3: Nawy does not take payment for trips. Travellers send a booking request and you agree the payment with them directly.
